messages:
sophia: Quick sync — starting a small probe to pick sample selection for the upcoming quant bakeoff (FP8 / INT8 / AWQ / GPTQ). Goal: find a compact eval set that is sensitive to accuracy deltas but keeps eval cost low. Also want a canary+fallback pattern that works across hosted / dedicated / private. Posting a short plan + questions.

sophia: Plan (short):
- build a 600-sample "probe set": stratify by length (short/med/long), intent (summarize/code/qa/dialog), and edge tokens.
- run 4-variant comparisons (fp8, int8, awq, gptq) against fp16 baseline on golden & probe sets.
- deploy canaries with staged traffic + metric gates, automatic fallback to nearest-compat variant.

sophia: Proposed canary config (example):
```
route_policy:
  - hosted:
      quant_variant: int8
      traffic: 0.5%
  - dedicated:
      quant_variant: awq
      traffic: 0.5%
  - private:
      quant_variant: fp8
      traffic: 2%
fallback_rules:
  - if golden.delta_accuracy_drop_pct > 1.0 -> rollback
  - if error_rate > 1% for 2m -> rollback
  - if latency_p95 > 2x baseline -> divert to fp16 baseline
```

max: SGTM. For the probe/golden sets — recommend 400 stratified + 200 adversarial (prompt-engineered edge cases). The adversarial set catches hallucination/regression modes.

oliver: Ops question: how do we wire this into SmartRouting? @infra-bot can we reserve a tiny dedicated pool for the canary to avoid noisy neighbors?

infra-bot: Ack. Reserved dedicated pool "ded-canary-small" = 2xV100-equivalent for 6 hours starting 1998765600. Will attach a tag so billing shows as 'ml-probe'.

eva: Metrics to track: golden.delta_exact_match, golden.rouge_delta, probe.perplexity_ratio, hallucination_count. Acceptance rule: no metric should exceed 0.8% median decline on golden; if a single metric > 1.5% on golden -> immediate rollback. Also monitor stratified slices (long-context, code prompts). :mag:

samir: Sequencing suggestion: Start with internal eval -> offline golden check. If pass, enable 0.1% live traffic on hosted & dedicated concurrently for 30m. Then scale to 0.5% for 2h. Private can use a higher initial % (2%) since it's isolated. Rollback triggers: 2 consecutive 1-min buckets with quality_drop > 1.2% OR error_rate > 1%.

max: Quick rollout CLI snippet (for anyone who needs it):
```
redwood rollout create \
  --model t5-large-int8-probe \
  --canary-hosted 0.1\
  --canary-dedicated 0.1\
  --canary-private 2\
  --golden-threshold 0.8\
  --fallback on_error,quality\
  --tags probe-sample-selection\
```

deploy-bot: Job queued: rollout-job-99201 for t5-large-int8-probe. Will post status updates here.

oliver: Note — if regressions appear specifically on long-context (>2048 tokens) samples, prefer routing those to fp8 variant for hosted while we iterate on kv-cache or tokenization fixes. :thinking_face:

sophia: Good call. We'll add a slice-rule: long-context -> prefer fp8 (hosted) with fallback to fp16. Also will include a small randomization seed in sampling (samplemix k=4) so different runs catch flaky regressions.

sophia: Thanks all — I'll run the probe tonight, upload eval CSV + diff report, and tag the ticket. If anyone wants to join the live window tomorrow morning ping me. :rocket:
